title: Words travel farther than drums
odia: ଚମବାଇଦ କୋଶେ, ତୁଣ୍ଡ ବାଇଦ ଶହସ୍ର କୋଶ
literal_meaning: A hide-drum carries one kos; the mouth’s drum a thousand kos.
explanation: News passed from person to person can spread much farther than a sound heard at its source. The contrast is deliberate exaggeration, not a measured claim about distance.
meaning_odia: ଢୋଲର ଶବ୍ଦ ଏକ ଦୂରତା ପରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏନାହିଁ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଲୋକମୁଖର କଥା ଜଣକଠାରୁ ଆଉ ଜଣକୁ ଯାଇଚାଲେ। ସେହିପାଇଁ ତୁଣ୍ଡର ବାଇଦକୁ ଅଧିକ ଦୂର ପହଞ୍ଚୁଥିବା କୁହାଯାଇଛି। ହଜାର କୋଶ ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତି; କଥା ଛାଡ଼ିବା ପରେ ତାହା କେତେ ଦୂର ଯାଇପାରେ ସେହି ଭାବଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
usage_example: A small announcement at a village gathering is being discussed in distant households the next day. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary’s sense1 is a report or rumour carried by word of mouth. The longer witness is retained; the discovery list gives only its latter idea.

odia_summary: ଢୋଲର ଶବ୍ଦ ଯେତେ ଦୂର ଯାଏ, ଲୋକମୁଖରେ ଚାଲୁଥିବା କଥା ତାଠାରୁ ବହୁ ଦୂର ପହଞ୍ଚେ। ହଜାର କୋଶ କଥାଟି ଏଠାରେ ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତି।
english_summary: Words passed from person to person can travel far beyond the original sound.
